decisions.reason: As a related industrial door variant that remained listed beyond launch, it likely met at least near-aspiration performance, and a large firm would usually retain such a product unless later results clearly fell short.

Its continued presence after launch and its fit with a core industrial insulated-door offering suggest acceptable performance relative to aspirations, so boundedly rational management would keep it while using organisational slack to support the line.

Because it had its own page and stayed visible through 2019, it appears to have had comparatively stronger internal support and market promise, making continuation the more likely choice unless new evidence of underperformance emerges.
